title: History
description: data of: history.py --json. What observing really costs, from every night kept (docs/observing-plan-spec.md, Phase 5). Each measure is a spread (median, 10th and 90th percentile, how many) or null when nothing measures it yet. Inferred measures say so.

before.description: With a date, only nights before that evening were counted, as a replay of it must be.

search_outcomes.description: How the searches of sessions with enough frames ended, counted: searched to the end, or stopped by a subtraction that did not match, no reference, or a stack that would not solve.

move_s.description: Inferred: last frame of one session to the first of the next, the same night, up to 20 minutes.

camera_retries.description: Recorded by the camera layer (TY_RETRY); null before any frame carried it.

depth_model_error.description: Measured depth less depth.py's model for the same stack, mag.
